newsitem.title: MEXICO: Werner named as Mexican deputy finance minister.
newsitem.headline: Werner named as Mexican deputy finance minister.

text.p: Martin Werner, the former director general of public credit at the Finance Ministry, has been named deputy finance minister to replace Jose Sidaoui, the ministry said on Wednesday.
Subject to Senate approval, he will be replaced as director of public credit by Carlos Mendoza, one of the top financial officers at state development bank Nacional Financiera.
Sidauoi on Tuesday was ratified by the Senate as deputy governor of Banco de Mexico, the central bank.
